purpose: Evaluator-only audit of gold-concept support in the frozen textbook corpus. This file does not modify the gold dataset.

support_levels.direct: The gold concept appears verbatim in the retrieved textbook evidence.
support_levels.variant: The gold concept is an accepted spelling, OCR, or terminology variant of an evidence term.
support_levels.inference: The gold concept is a paraphrase, application, or classification inference supported by the evidence but not stated verbatim.
support_levels.external: The gold concept is not supported by the provided textbook corpus and would require external knowledge.
support_levels.uncertain: The corpus does not contain enough evidence to decide whether the gold wording is supported.

questions.question: ក្នុងប្រឡង៖ តើអ្វីជានិយមន័យរបស់ហ្សែន (gene)?

concepts.evidence_quote: សែនជាអង្គធាតុមួយរបស់ ADN ដែលផ្ទុកព័ត៌មានសេនេទិចកំណត់សំយោគប្រតេអ៊ីនប្រភេទមួយ ។
concepts.alias_mode_rule: សែន requires local gene context (ADN, genetic information, nucleotide, chromosome, trait determination, or protein synthesis).
concepts.justification: The textbook definition on p174 uses សែន for gene; the transliteration ហ្សែន appears on pp.204-205. The saved answer defines សែន with ADN and genetic information, so the alias is a verified spelling variant in gene context.

questions.notes: Strict coverage is 0.0 only because the gold label uses ហ្សែន while the answer uses the textbook spelling សែន. Alias-aware coverage becomes 1.0. The definition itself is scientifically correct.

questions.question: ចូរបង្កើតសំណួរសាកល្បង 3 អំពីការស្រូបទឹករបស់រុក្ខជាតិ

concepts.evidence_quote: រុក្ខជាតិមានសរសៃរស្រូបយកទឹកពីក្នុងដីតាមរយៈរោមជញ្ជក់នៃប្ដូរ ។
accepted_aliases: ស្រូបយកទឹក
concepts.alias_mode_rule: ស្រូបយកទឹក requires local plant/root/soil/root-hair/xylem context.
concepts.justification: p026_001 uses ការស្រូបទឹក and p026_002 uses ស្រូបយកទឹក for the same root-absorption process. The saved quiz answer uses the latter in a plant/soil context.

questions.notes: Alias-aware coverage becomes 1.0. Helpfulness remains 3 because the quiz-format proxy expects the phrase សំណួរទី; that is a separate format heuristic, not a biological error.

questions.question: តើស៊ីឡែមនិងដូអែមខុសគ្នាដូចម្តេច?

concepts.evidence_quote: ស៊ីឡែមមាននាទីដឹកនាំទឹកនិងអំបិលខនិជពីឫសតាមដើមទៅកាន់ស្លឹករបស់រុក្ខជាតិ ។
concepts.justification: ស៊ីឡែម is the standard term and appears directly in the evidence.

concepts.evidence_quote: ផ្លូអែមជាជាលិកានាំ វាដឹកនាំអាហារទៅគ្រប់កោសិកាទាំងអស់ដែលមិនអាចធ្វើរស្មីសំយោគបាន ។
concepts.alias_mode_rule: ផ្លូអែម requires local food/organic-transport context (អាហារ, organic substances, photosynthesis, sugar, or carbohydrate).
concepts.justification: ដូអែម occurs once on p13 as an OCR/spelling variant, while the standard and repeatedly defined term is ផ្លូអែម. The saved answer uses ផ្លូអែម and correctly describes food transport.

questions.notes: Alias-aware coverage becomes 1.0. The guard is important: a statement that phloem transports water but not food must not receive phloem credit merely because ផ្លូអែម appears.

questions.question: ពន្យល់ពីតួនាទីរបស់ប្រូតេអ៊ីនក្នុងសារពាង្គកាយ
gold_concepts: ប្រូតេអ៊ីន

concepts.concept: ប្រូតេអ៊ីន
concepts.evidence_quote: 2. នាទីរបស់ប្រូតេអ៊ីន
concepts.justification: The term appears directly throughout the protein lesson.

concepts.evidence_quote: 2. នាទីរបស់ប្រូតេអ៊ីន
concepts.alias_mode_rule: នាទី requires local protein context (ប្រូតេអ៊ីន) within the same window.
concepts.justification: The textbook heading uses នាទីរបស់ប្រូតេអ៊ីន; the answer uses the same role word. The guard prevents unrelated role statements (for example, នាទីរបស់ឫស) from matching this gold concept.

questions.notes: Alias-aware coverage becomes 1.0. The answer's protein roles are substantively correct.

questions.question: តើគេអាចបង្ការជំងឺពកកបានដោយរបៀបណា?
gold_concepts: អាហារសមុទ្រ

concepts.evidence_quote: ជំងឺពកកអាចបញ្ដារបាន ដោយបរិភោគអាហារមានជាតិអ៊ីយ៉ូត ។
concepts.justification: The evidence uses បញ្ដារ (prevent) rather than បង្ការ; the gold concept is a paraphrase of the same preventive recommendation.

concepts.evidence_quote: ដែលបណ្តាលឱ្យពកក ។
concepts.justification: The disease name appears verbatim in the evidence.

concepts.evidence_quote: ជំងឺពកកអាចបញ្ដារបាន ដោយបរិភោគអាហារមានជាតិអ៊ីយ៉ូត ។
concepts.justification: Iodine is stated directly as the preventive nutrient.

concepts.alias_mode_rule: Not aliased. No alias-aware credit is given.
concepts.justification: Although អំបិល occurs in 12 corpus chunks, none co-occurs with អ៊ីយ៉ូត. The page-109 recommendation names iodine-rich food, គ្រឿន, and seafood, not iodized salt. Iodized salt is external to the retrieved evidence. The frozen gold record is retained unchanged.

concepts.concept: អាហារសមុទ្រ
concepts.evidence_quote: គ្រិនិងអាហារសមុទ្រផ្សេងៗជាប្រភពដ៏ល្អនៃជាតិអ៊ីយ៉ូត ។
concepts.justification: Seafood is named directly as an iodine source.

questions.notes: Saved answer matches 4/5 concepts. The missing អំបិល is a gold/corpus support mismatch, not an answer hallucination. Coverage stays 0.8 in both modes. The answer is evidence-grounded; the frozen label is unchanged.

questions.question: តើស្វាយជារុក្ខជាតិឌីកូទីលេដូន ឬ រុក្ខជាតិម៉ូណូកូទីលេដូន?
gold_concepts: ឌីកូទីលេដូន
ទ្រនុងបែកខ្នែង

concepts.evidence_quote: ឯស្វាយស្ថិតនៅក្នុងក្រុមអង់ស្យូស្ពែម ។
concepts.justification: Mango is named as an angiosperm example. The textbook does not explicitly classify mango as monocot or dicot; that classification is an application inference.

concepts.concept: ឌីកូទីលេដូន
concepts.evidence_quote: ឯរុក្ខជាតិឌីកូទីលេដូនមានច្រើនរាប់មិនអស់ ។
concepts.justification: The classification term appears directly in the comparison.

concepts.evidence_quote: | គ្រាប់ | កូទីលេដុងមួយ | កូទីលេដុងពីរ |
concepts.justification: The dicot trait is directly tabulated: two cotyledons. The saved answer omits it.

concepts.concept: ទ្រនុងបែកខ្នែង
concepts.evidence_quote: ស្លឹកមានទ្រនុងបែកមែក ។ ... | ស្លឹក | ទ្រនុងស្រប | ទ្រនុងបែកខ្នែង |
accepted_aliases: ទ្រនុងបែកមែក
concepts.alias_mode_rule: ទ្រនុងបែកមែក requires local leaf/dicot/vein context.
concepts.justification: Both forms occur on p19 and describe the same dicot leaf-venation trait. The saved answer uses ទ្រនុងបែកមែក in a leaf context.

concepts.evidence_quote: | ឫស | ឫសព្រែក | ឫសកែវ |
concepts.justification: The dicot root trait is directly tabulated. The saved answer omits it.

questions.notes: Alias-aware coverage rises from 0.4 to 0.6, but the answer still omits កូទីលេដុង and ឫសកែវ and never commits to the explicit statement that mango is a dicot. The application/decisiveness failure remains.

questions.question: តើលក្ខណៈបន្សំសំដៅលើអ្វី?
gold_concepts: ជម្រើសដោយធម្មជាតិ

concepts.evidence_quote: ការសម្របប្រួលរបស់ភាវៈរស់ទៅនឹងមជ្ឈដ្ឋានដើម្បី រស់រាននិងបង្កើតកូនចៅជំនាន់ក្រោយ ហៅថា បន្លំ ។
concepts.alias_mode_rule: បន្លំ/បន្លាំ require local adaptation context and are rejected in counterfeiting context.
concepts.justification: The textbook uses បន្លំ and បន្លាំ for adaptation; បន្ស៊ាំ is the standard form used by the answer. The answer's definition is textbook-faithful.

concepts.concept: ជម្រើសដោយធម្មជាតិ
concepts.evidence_quote: ជម្រើសដោយធម្មជាតិជាដំណើរដែលឯកត្តៈមានបន្ស៊ាំទៅនឹងមជ្ឈដ្ឋានប្រសើរជាងគេ អាចរស់រានមានជីវិតនិងធ្វើការបន្តពូជបានច្រើនជាងភាវៈរស់ដទៃទៀតក្នុងប្រភេទតែមួយ ។
concepts.alias_mode_rule: No alias. The mechanism must be expressed, not inferred from adaptation words.
concepts.justification: The textbook defines natural selection as differential survival and reproduction of better-adapted individuals. The saved answer defines adaptation and inheritance but never mentions natural selection, differential survival, or differential reproduction. The genuine explanatory gap remains.

questions.notes: Coverage remains 0.5 in both modes. The answer is a correct adaptation definition but an incomplete answer to the natural-selection mechanism. This gap must not be hidden by alias expansion.

questions.question: ចូរពន្យល់ពីដំណើរការលំអងរបស់ស្រល់

concepts.evidence_quote: មីក្រូស្ព័រ៉ង់ផលិតគ្រាប់លំអងឬមីក្រូស្ព័រ ។
concepts.justification: លំអង is a direct substring of the textbook term គ្រាប់លំអង and is present in the saved answer.

concepts.alias_mode_rule: Not aliased to គ្រាប់លំអង. The two expressions are not treated as universally interchangeable.
concepts.justification: លំអងផ្កា has 0 occurrences in the corpus, while គ្រាប់លំអង occurs 53 times in 17 chunks and is the textbook term for the gymnosperm pollen grain. The gold wording is not evidenced as written; the answer's គ្រាប់លំអង is scientifically appropriate. Group C remains non-equivalent for this evaluated concept.

questions.notes: Coverage remains 0.5 in both modes. The low strict score reflects a gold-wording limitation, not a missing pollen mechanism. Do not alias លំអងផ្កា to គ្រាប់លំអង without a separate gold-label review.
